<script>
(function() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('nexusBootOverlay');
  const stageEl = document.getElementById('nexusBootStage');
  if (!overlay) return;

  document.body.classList.add('nexus-booting');

  const stages = [
    "Warming up the GPU…",
    "Loading shaders…",
    "Preparing simulation…",
    "Building controls…",
    "Calibrating chaos…",
    "Finalizing scene…"
  ];
  let i = 0;
  const tick = () => {
    if (!stageEl) return;
    stageEl.textContent = stages[i % stages.length];
    i++;
  };
  tick();
  const iv = setInterval(tick, 900);

  const done = () => {
    if (!document.getElementById('nexusBootOverlay')) return;
    clearInterval(iv);
    overlay.style.opacity = '0';
    overlay.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    setTimeout(() => {
      overlay.remove();
      document.body.classList.remove('nexus-booting');
    }, 260);
  };

  // Optional: labs may call this when fully ready.
  window.__NEXUS_LAB_READY__ = done;

  // Fallback heuristic: once a canvas exists and is sized, we allow a short grace window, then hide.
  const start = Date.now();
  const maxWait = 15000; // safety valve
  const poll = () => {
    if (Date.now() - start > maxWait) return done();
    const canv = document.querySelector('canvas');
    if (canv && canv.clientWidth > 0 && canv.clientHeight > 0) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => setTimeout(done, 220));
      return;
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(poll);
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(poll);

  // If the lab finishes fast, don't force a long overlay.
  window.addEventListener('load', () => setTimeout(() => {
    // If the canvas never appears, still remove after a while so the user can see any error UI.
    if (Date.now() - start > 2500) done();
  }, 50), { once: true });
})();
</script>

<div aria-labelledby="splash2Title" aria-modal="true" class="modal-shell" id="splash2" role="dialog" style="display:none; z-index: 9500;">

<button class="modal-close" id="closeSplash2" title="Close" type="button">Close</button>

<div class="modal-body" style="max-height: min(72vh, 720px);">
<div style="font-size:16pt;color:#cbd5f5;line-height:1.65;">
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.72rem;margin-bottom:8px;">What this app is</div>
<p style="margin:0 0 10px;">
            AEON is an interactive browser-based 3D “lab” that lets you jump between several celestial bodies and view them with cinematic rendering and layered visual effects.
            It is intended as a portfolio piece that demonstrates procedural modeling, shader customization, UI integration, and robust runtime safety.
          </p>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.72rem;margin:14px 0 8px;">How to use it (step-by-step)</div>
<ol style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Pick a target body</b>: Use the TARGET // BODY buttons to warp between Saturn, Pluto, Mars, Ceres, and Europa. Warp includes a brief tunnel + stability reset.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Move the camera</b>: Drag to orbit, wheel/pinch to zoom. The camera always targets the body center; panning is disabled for presentation clarity.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Control lighting</b>: Use the Sun Angle slider to move the key light. Toggle <b>ECLIPSE</b> for dramatic rim lighting and night-side reveals.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Binary Star</b>: Toggle <b>BINARY STAR</b> to add a second directional source and enable signal-spectrum overlays in the sky.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Run a scan</b>: Click <b>INITIATE SCAN</b> to sweep an X‑Ray scanline through the scene. This temporarily reveals hidden patterns and boosts night-side signals.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>HERO CAM</b>: Enables an automated cinematic camera path. Toggle again to return to manual orbit controls.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Presentation mode</b>: Press <b>P</b> or double-tap the viewport to hide UI and showcase the render full-screen.</li>
</ol>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.72rem;margin:14px 0 8px;">Quality, performance, and what to do if it stutters</div>
<ul style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Quality toggle</b>: Use the Quality pill (or press <b>Q</b>) to switch between High and Low pixel ratio/exposure presets.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Screen FX toggle</b>: Press <b>V</b> to disable the overlay FX stack if your device is struggling.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>INSANE MODE</b>: If enabled, final-pass chromatic aberration and stronger anomaly events will run. Disable it for stability on low-end devices.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>If the render is blank</b>: Resize the window (forces renderer resize), then reload. WebGL can fail if GPU resources are exhausted.</li>
</ul>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.72rem;margin:14px 0 8px;">Hidden / advanced controls</div>
<ul style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Konami code</b>: Enter ↑ ↑ ↓ ↓ ← → ← → B A to open a lightweight internal dev readout.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Escape</b>: closes any open modal windows.</li>
</ul>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.72rem;margin:14px 0 8px;">What the effects are doing (plain English)</div>
<p style="margin:0 0 10px;">
            The ring iridescence is computed by simulating thin-film interference: as your view angle changes, the color shifts without relying on emissive glow.
            Scans and signals inject shader overlays that highlight structures by mixing in colored grids and scanlines.
            Background anomalies (occultation flicker, silent void, beacons) are intentionally subtle—visible cues become more obvious during eclipse, scan pulses, and INSANE mode.
          </p>

<section aria-label="README / Operator Guide" class="sidebar-section">
<div class="sidebar-title"><span>README</span><span>DROPDOWN</span></div>
<details id="readmeDropdown" style="font-size:0.74rem; color:#cbd5f5; line-height:1.55;">
<summary style="cursor:pointer; user-select:none; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#e5e7eb; font-size:0.66rem;">
        Open detailed operator readme
      </summary>
<div style="margin-top:10px; color:#cbd5f5;">
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.68rem;margin-bottom:6px;">Purpose</div>
<p style="margin:0 0 10px;">
          AEON is a single-page, single-file real-time 3D portfolio application. It demonstrates procedural geometry, custom shader augmentation
          (onBeforeCompile + custom ShaderMaterials), runtime UX tooling, and stable scene rebuilding across multiple “world presets.”
        </p>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.68rem;margin:12px 0 6px;">Core interactions</div>
<ul style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Orbit</b>: click/touch-drag in the viewport.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Zoom</b>: mouse wheel / trackpad pinch / touch pinch.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Warp</b>: click a body button. The app temporarily disables controls, runs a transition, rebuilds the world, then re-enables controls.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Scan</b>: runs a vertical scanline that injects a grid highlight into shaders (planet + rings).</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Presentation</b>: press <b>P</b> or double-tap to hide UI chrome.</li>
</ul>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.68rem;margin:12px 0 6px;">Keyboard shortcuts</div>
<ul style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>P</b>: Presentation mode toggle.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Q</b>: Quality High/Low.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>V</b>: Toggle screen FX overlay stack.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>I</b>: Toggle INSANE MODE (if enabled in this build).</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:6px;"><b>Esc</b>: Close modals.</li>
</ul>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.68rem;margin:12px 0 6px;">Troubleshooting</div>
<ol style="margin:0 0 10px 18px; padding:0;">
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Low FPS</b>: toggle Quality to Low, then press V to disable overlay FX. Avoid INSANE mode on mobile.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Visual artifacts after warp</b>: warp again to the same body (forces rebuild). This build also hard-clears Saturn-only artifacts when switching bodies.</li>
<li style="margin-bottom:8px;"><b>Blank canvas</b>: reload the page. Some GPUs/drivers can lose WebGL context after heavy memory pressure.</li>
</ol>
<div style="color:#e5e7eb;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:0.68rem;margin:12px 0 6px;">Implementation notes (plain English)</div>
<p style="margin:0;">
          Each body rebuild disposes old geometry/materials and recreates procedural meshes. Saturn uses a custom band shader with a thin-film “oil slick” response.
          Rings are ShaderMaterials with scan uniforms injected. The app uses a small amount of controlled randomness for natural variation; any persistent artifacts
          are aggressively cleared on rebuild to prevent cross-body contamination.
        </p>
</div>
</details>

    // ========= FASTMATH (3D⁹ noise pack) =========    
    const FastMath = (() => {    
      const fract = (x) => x - Math.floor(x);    
      const lerp  = (a,b,t) => a + (b-a)*t;    
      const fade  = (t) => t*t*t*(t*(t*6-15)+10);    
    
      function hash2(x, y){ return fract(Math.sin(x*127.1 + y*311.7) * 43758.5453123); }    
      function hash3(x, y, z){ return fract(Math.sin(x*127.1 + y*311.7 + z*74.7) * 43758.5453123); }    
    
      function noise2(x, y){    
        const X = Math.floor(x), Y = Math.floor(y);    
        const xf = x - X, yf = y - Y;    
        const u = fade(xf), v = fade(yf);    
        const a = hash2(X, Y), b = hash2(X+1, Y), c = hash2(X, Y+1), d = hash2(X+1, Y+1);    
        return lerp(lerp(a, b, u), lerp(c, d, u), v);    
      }    
    
      function noise3(x, y, z){    
        const X = Math.floor(x), Y = Math.floor(y), Z = Math.floor(z);    
        const xf = x - X, yf = y - Y, zf = z - Z;    
        const u = fade(xf), v = fade(yf), w = fade(zf);    
        const n000 = hash3(X,Y,Z), n100 = hash3(X+1,Y,Z), n010 = hash3(X,Y+1,Z), n110 = hash3(X+1,Y+1,Z);    
        const n001 = hash3(X,Y,Z+1), n101 = hash3(X+1,Y,Z+1), n011 = hash3(X,Y+1,Z+1), n111 = hash3(X+1,Y+1,Z+1);    
        return lerp(lerp(lerp(n000, n100, u), lerp(n010, n110, u), v), lerp(lerp(n001, n101, u), lerp(n011, n111, u), v), w);    
      }    
    
      function fbm3(x,y,z, oct=5){    
        let f = 0, amp = 0.5, freq = 1.0;    
        for(let i=0;i<oct;i++){ f += amp * (noise3(x*freq, y*freq, z*freq)*2 - 1); freq *= 2.0; amp *= 0.5; }    
        return f;    
      }    
    
      function ridged3(x,y,z, oct=5){    
        let f = 0, amp = 0.5, freq = 1.0;    
        for(let i=0;i<oct;i++){ f += amp * (1.0 - Math.abs(noise3(x*freq, y*freq, z*freq)*2 - 1.0)); freq *= 2.0; amp *= 0.5; }    
        return f;    
      }    
    
      function warp3(x,y,z, strength=0.6){    
        const wx = fbm3(x+11.1, y+7.2, z+3.3, 3), wy = fbm3(x+1.7, y+19.3,z+9.1, 3), wz = fbm3(x+5.9, y+2.4, z+17.8,3);    
        return { x: x + wx*strength, y: y + wy*strength, z: z + wz*strength };    
      }    
    
      return { noise: noise2, noise2, noise3, fbm3, ridged3, warp3 };    
    })();

    }

    function buildStars(){
      if (starsMesh) { scene.remove(starsMesh); starsMesh.geometry.dispose(); starsMesh.material.dispose(); starsMesh = null; }      const __qp = (window.NexusPrefs && window.NexusPrefs.qualityProfile) ? window.NexusPrefs.qualityProfile() : { particleScale: 1 };
      const count = Math.max(1200, Math.round(5200 * (Number(__qp.particleScale) || 1)));
      const pos = new Float32Array(count * 3);
      const size = new Float32Array(count);
      const rng = () => (Math.random() * 2 - 1);
      for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
        const r = 300 + Math.random()*350;
        const v = new THREE.Vector3(rng(), rng(), rng()).normalize().multiplyScalar(r);
        pos[i*3]=v.x; pos[i*3+1]=v.y; pos[i*3+2]=v.z;
        size[i] = 1.0 + Math.random()*1.8;
      }
      const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
      geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos, 3));
      geo.setAttribute('aSize', new THREE.BufferAttribute(size, 1));
      const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
        uniforms: {
          uTime: { value: 0 },
          uSpeed: { value: 0 },
          uOpacity: { value: 0.92 },
        },
        vertexShader: `attribute float aSize; uniform float uTime; uniform float uSpeed; varying float vTw; void main(){
          vec3 p = position;
          float tw = 0.5 + 0.5*sin(uTime*0.8 + p.x*0.02 + p.y*0.013);
          vTw = tw;
          vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(p, 1.0);
          gl_PointSize = aSize * (1.0 + uSpeed*0.15) * (300.0 / -mv.z);
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv;
        }`,
        fragmentShader: `precision highp float; uniform float uOpacity; varying float vTw; void main(){
          vec2 uv = gl_PointCoord - 0.5;
          float d = length(uv);
          float a = smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, d);
          vec3 col = mix(vec3(0.55,0.75,1.0), vec3(1.0,0.8,0.6), vTw);
          gl_FragColor = vec4(col, a * uOpacity);
        }`
      });
      starsMesh = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
      starsMesh.frustumCulled = false;
      scene.add(starsMesh);
    }

    function buildNebula(){
      if (nebulaMesh) { scene.remove(nebulaMesh); nebulaMesh.geometry.dispose(); nebulaMesh.material.dispose(); nebulaMesh = null; }
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(500, 24, 16);
      const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        side: THREE.BackSide,
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        uniforms: {
          uTime: { value: 0 },
          uColorSet: { value: new THREE.Vector3(0.1, 0.4, 0.5) },
          uOpacity: { value: 0.25 }
        },
        vertexShader: `varying vec3 vP; void main(){ vP = position; gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); }`,
        fragmentShader: `precision highp float; varying vec3 vP; uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uColorSet; uniform float uOpacity;
          float hash(vec3 p){ p=fract(p*0.1031); p += dot(p,p.yzx+33.33); return fract((p.x+p.y)*p.z); }
          float noise(vec3 p){ vec3 i=floor(p), f=fract(p); f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f);
            float n000=hash(i), n100=hash(i+vec3(1,0,0)), n010=hash(i+vec3(0,1,0)), n110=hash(i+vec3(1,1,0));
            float n001=hash(i+vec3(0,0,1)), n101=hash(i+vec3(1,0,1)), n011=hash(i+vec3(0,1,1)), n111=hash(i+vec3(1,1,1));
            return mix(mix(mix(n000,n100,f.x), mix(n010,n110,f.x), f.y), mix(mix(n001,n101,f.x), mix(n011,n111,f.x), f.y), f.z);
          }
          float fbm(vec3 p){ float f=0.0; float a=0.5; for(int i=0;i<5;i++){ f += a*(noise(p)*2.0-1.0); p*=2.0; a*=0.5; } return f; }
          void main(){
            vec3 p = normalize(vP) * 2.2;
            float n = fbm(p + vec3(0.0, 0.0, uTime*0.02));
            float m = smoothstep(-0.35, 0.55, n);
            vec3 col = mix(vec3(0.02,0.03,0.08), uColorSet, m);
            gl_FragColor = vec4(col, uOpacity * m);
          }`
      });
      nebulaMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      nebulaMesh.frustumCulled = false;
      scene.add(nebulaMesh);
    }

    function addAtmosphereForBody(bodyKey){
      // remove previous
      if (atmosphereMesh) { scene.remove(atmosphereMesh); atmosphereMesh.geometry.dispose(); atmosphereMesh.material.dispose(); atmosphereMesh = null; }
      // very subtle, body-dependent atmosphere shell
      const hasAtmo = (bodyKey === 'saturn' || bodyKey === 'mars' || bodyKey === 'europa' || bodyKey === 'pluto');
      if (!hasAtmo) return;
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS * 1.02, 64, 48);
      const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
        transparent: true,
        depthWrite: false,
        blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
        uniforms: {
          uPower: { value: bodyKey === 'mars' ? 2.8 : 3.4 },
          uDensity: { value: bodyKey === 'mars' ? 0.32 : 0.20 },
          uColor: { value: new THREE.Color(bodyKey === 'mars' ? 0xff9a6b : 0x66ccff) }
        },
        vertexShader: `varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vW; void main(){
          vN = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
          vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
          vW = wp.xyz;
          gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp;
        }`,
        fragmentShader: `precision highp float; varying vec3 vN; varying vec3 vW; uniform float uPower; uniform float uDensity; uniform vec3 uColor;
          void main(){
            vec3 V = normalize(cameraPosition - vW);
            float f = pow(max(0.0, 1.0 - dot(vN, V)), uPower);
            gl_FragColor = vec4(uColor, f * uDensity);
          }`
      });
      atmosphereMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
      atmosphereMesh.frustumCulled = false;
      scene.add(atmosphereMesh);
    }

        controls.minDistance = body.camera.min ?? controls.minDistance;    
        controls.maxDistance = body.camera.max ?? controls.maxDistance;    
        controls.target.set(0,0,0);
        controls.update();    
      }    
    }

    function updateSunLight(){    
      if (!dirLight) return;
      const isEclipse = Store.state.eclipse;
      const angleRad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(Store.state.sunAngle);
      const dist = 80;    
      let x, y, z;
      const gr = document.getElementById('god-rays');
      if (isEclipse) { x = 0; y = 0; z = -dist; if (gr) gr.classList.add('active'); } 
      else { x = Math.cos(angleRad) * dist; y = Math.sin(angleRad) * dist * 0.6; z = 40; if (gr) gr.classList.remove('active'); }
      
      if (atmosphereMesh && atmosphereMesh.material && atmosphereMesh.material.uniforms) {
          atmosphereMesh.material.uniforms.uPower.value = isEclipse ? 5.0 : (Store.state.body === 'mars' ? 2.8 : 3.4);
          atmosphereMesh.material.uniforms.uDensity.value = isEclipse ? (0.35) : (Store.state.body === 'mars' ? 0.32 : 0.20);
      }
      dirLight.position.set(x, y, z); dirLight.target.position.set(0,0,0); dirLight.target.updateMatrixWorld();    
      if (rimLight){ rimLight.intensity = isEclipse ? 0 : 0.3; rimLight.position.set(-x*0.8, -y*0.3, -25); rimLight.target.position.set(0,0,0); rimLight.target.updateMatrixWorld(); }
      if (bounceLight) { bounceLight.intensity = (Store.state.body === 'saturn' && !isEclipse) ? 0.4 : 0; bounceLight.position.set(-x*0.5, -y*0.5, -z*0.5); }
      if (secondaryDirLight) { secondaryDirLight.intensity = Store.state.binary ? 1.2 : 0; const sA = angleRad + 2.5; secondaryDirLight.position.set(Math.cos(sA)*dist, Math.sin(sA)*dist*0.5, 30); }
    }    

    function setQuality(q){
      FX.quality = q;
      document.getElementById('qualityLabel').textContent = q === 'high' ? 'High' : 'Low';
      if (document.getElementById('canvasFx')) document.getElementById('canvasFx').style.filter = q === 'high' ? 'saturate(1.22) contrast(1.04)' : 'saturate(1.10) contrast(1.02)';
      if (renderer) { renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(((window.UIHelpers && typeof window.UIHelpers.getPixelRatio==="function") ? window.UIHelpers.getPixelRatio("aeon") : (window.devicePixelRatio||1)) || 1, q === 'high' ? FX.dprHigh : FX.dprLow)); renderer.toneMappingExposure = q === 'high' ? FX.exposureHigh : FX.exposureLow; }
      if (starsMesh && starsMesh.material){ starsMesh.material.uniforms.uOpacity.value = q === 'high' ? 0.92 : 0.82; starsMesh.material.needsUpdate = true; }
      logOps(`Quality set to ${q.toUpperCase()}.`);
    }

    function applyGrading(mode) {
      Store.set({ grade: mode });
      // FIX: do not nuke other body classes (like presentation-mode)
      document.body.classList.remove('grade-cinematic','grade-deep','grade-analog');
      document.body.classList.add(`grade-${mode}`);
      document.querySelectorAll('.visuals-grid .btn-toggle').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      const b = document.getElementById(`grade-${mode}`);
      if (b) b.classList.add('active');
      if (nebulaMesh && nebulaMesh.material && nebulaMesh.material.uniforms) {
        const c = nebulaMesh.material.uniforms.uColorSet.value;
        if (mode === 'cinematic') c.set(0.1, 0.4, 0.5); else if (mode === 'deep') c.set(0.05, 0.1, 0.6); else if (mode === 'analog') c.set(0.4, 0.3, 0.2); 
      }
      logOps(`Color Grading: ${mode.toUpperCase()} loaded.`);
    }

    }

    function triggerWarp(targetBody) {
        if (transitionActive) return;
        transitionActive = true;
        if (controls) controls.enabled = false;

        // Feature 33: space-time ripple grid during warp
        pulseSpaceGrid(1.15);

        const start = performance.now();
        const animateWarp = () => {
            const now = performance.now();
            const p = Math.min((now - start)/1000, 1.0);
            if (starsMesh && starsMesh.material && starsMesh.material.uniforms) starsMesh.material.uniforms.uSpeed.value = Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 4.0; 
            // Feature 42: stronger occultation flicker during warp in insane
            if (insaneMode) bumpOccultation(0.55);
            if(p < 1.0) requestAnimationFrame(animateWarp);
            else if (starsMesh && starsMesh.material && starsMesh.material.uniforms) starsMesh.material.uniforms.uSpeed.value = 0;
        };
        animateWarp();
        const wo = document.getElementById('warp-overlay');
        if (wo) wo.classList.add('active');
        setTimeout(() => {
             Store.set({ body: targetBody });    
             updateBodyUI(); buildWorld(); updateChemistryPanel(); updateSunLight(); applyBodyCameraPreset(targetBody);
             
             // Hard reset controls to kill momentum
             if (controls) {
               controls.reset();
               controls.target.set(0,0,0);
             }
             const body = BODIES[targetBody];
             if(body && body.camera && camera) camera.position.set(...body.camera.pos);
             
             if (wo) wo.classList.remove('active');
             if (controls) controls.enabled = true; transitionActive = false;
             logOps(`Warp jump to ${BODIES[targetBody].label} complete.`);
        }, 600);
    }
    
    function toggleHeroCam() {
        if (transitionActive) return;
        heroCamActive = !heroCamActive;
        const btn = document.getElementById('heroCamBtn');
        if (heroCamActive) {
            btn.classList.add('active'); btn.innerText = "EXIT HERO"; if (controls) controls.enabled = false; heroCamTime = 0; logOps("HERO CAMERA SEQUENCE INITIATED.");
        } else {
            btn.classList.remove('active'); btn.innerText = "HERO CAM"; if (controls) controls.enabled = true; logOps("Manual control restored.");
        }
    }
    
    function triggerScan() {
        if (Store.state.scanning) return;
        Store.set({ scanning: true });
        let startTime = clock.elapsedTime; const scanDuration = 3.0;

        // Feature 33 + 43/46/49/54: scan disturbs space + reveals hidden patterns / lights
        pulseSpaceGrid(1.05);

        const animateScan = () => {
             const t = clock.elapsedTime - startTime; const progress = t / scanDuration;
             const scanY = (progress * 2.0 - 1.0) * (BASE_RADIUS * 1.2);
             if (worldMesh && worldMesh.material.userData.shader) {
                 worldMesh.material.userData.shader.uniforms.uScanY.value = scanY; worldMesh.material.userData.shader.uniforms.uScanActive.value = 1.0;
             }
             ringMeshes.forEach(mesh => {
                 if (mesh.material.uniforms) { mesh.material.uniforms.uScanY.value = scanY; mesh.material.uniforms.uScanActive.value = 1.0; }
             });

             // temporarily boost night-side lattices/veins visibility during scan
             setNightSignalsIntensity(0.85);
             if (insaneMode) bumpOccultation(0.35);

             if (t < scanDuration) { requestAnimationFrame(animateScan); } 
             else {
                 Store.set({ scanning: false });
                 if (worldMesh && worldMesh.material.userData.shader) worldMesh.material.userData.shader.uniforms.uScanActive.value = 0.0;
                 ringMeshes.forEach(m => { if (m.material.uniforms) m.material.uniforms.uScanActive.value = 0.0; });
                 setNightSignalsIntensity(0.0);
                 logOps("Surface scan complete.");
             }
        };
        logOps("Scanning surface geometry..."); animateScan();
    }

    // DISPOSAL HELPER
    function disposeHierarchy(obj) {
      if (!obj) return;
      obj.traverse((child) => {
        if (child.isMesh || child.isLine || child.isPoints) {
          if (child.geometry) child.geometry.dispose();
          if (child.material) {
            if (Array.isArray(child.material)) child.material.forEach(m => { 
                Object.values(m).forEach(v => { if (v && v.isTexture) v.dispose(); });
                m.dispose(); 
            });
            else { 
                Object.values(child.material).forEach(v => { if (v && v.isTexture) v.dispose(); });
                child.material.dispose(); 
            }
          }
        }
      });
    }

    function buildMarsGeometry(){
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS, 200, 150);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3();
      for (let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos,i);
        const r=v.length(), nx=v.x/r, ny=v.y/r, nz=v.z/r;
        const lat = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny))), lon = Math.atan2(nz,nx);
        const latDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lat), lonDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lon);
        let height = 0; const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*2.2, ny*2.2, nz*2.2, 0.35); height += FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*6.0,noisePos.y*6.0,noisePos.z*6.0,5) * 0.55;
        if (latDeg > -25 && latDeg < 35 && lonDeg > -150 && lonDeg < -50) {
          const latNorm=(latDeg+25)/60, lonNorm=(lonDeg+150)/100, d=Math.hypot(latNorm-0.5, lonNorm-0.5); height += Math.max(0,1-d*2.1)*2.3;
        }
        if (Math.abs(latDeg)<18 && lonDeg>-115 && lonDeg<-35){
          const equ = 1 - Math.abs(latDeg)/18, dLon = Math.abs(lonDeg - (-75))/35; height -= equ*Math.max(0,1-dLon)*2.8;
        }
        if (Math.abs(latDeg)>70) height *= 0.35;
        const factor = 1.0 + (height / BASE_RADIUS); pos.setXYZ(i, v.x*factor, v.y*factor, v.z*factor);
      }
      pos.needsUpdate = true; geo.computeVertexNormals(); return geo;
    }

    function buildPlutoGeometry(){
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS, 200, 150);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3();
      for (let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos,i); v.y *= 0.98;
        const r=v.length(), nx=v.x/r, ny=v.y/r, nz=v.z/r;
        const lat = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny))), lon = Math.atan2(nz,nx);
        const latDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lat), lonDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lon);
        let height = 0; const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*2.0, ny*2.0, nz*2.0, 0.45); height += FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*5.0,noisePos.y*5.0,noisePos.z*5.0,5) * 0.38;
        if (latDeg > -42 && latDeg < 20 && lonDeg > -45 && lonDeg < 45){
          const latNorm=(latDeg+42)/62, lonNorm=(lonDeg+45)/90, d=Math.hypot((lonNorm-0.5)*1.5, (latNorm-0.55)); height -= Math.max(0,1-d*2.2)*1.4;
        }
        const pit = FastMath.noise3(nx*9.0+7.1, ny*9.0-2.3, nz*9.0+1.7); if (pit > 0.78) height -= (pit-0.78)*1.4;
        const factor = 1.0 + (height / BASE_RADIUS); pos.setXYZ(i, v.x*factor, v.y*factor, v.z*factor);
      }
      pos.needsUpdate = true; geo.computeVertexNormals(); return geo;
    }

    function buildCeresGeometry(){
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS, 200, 150);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3();
      const craters = [{ latDeg: 12, lonDeg: 30, radiusDeg: 18, depth: 1.7 }, { latDeg: -10, lonDeg: -40, radiusDeg: 14, depth: 1.4 }, { latDeg: 35, lonDeg: -90, radiusDeg: 10, depth: 1.2 }];
      for (let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos,i);
        const r=v.length(), nx=v.x/r, ny=v.y/r, nz=v.z/r;
        const lat = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny))), lon = Math.atan2(nz,nx);
        const latDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lat), lonDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lon);
        let height = 0; const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*2.6, ny*2.6, nz*2.6, 0.30); height += FastMath.ridged3(noisePos.x*6.0,noisePos.y*6.0,noisePos.z*6.0,5) * 0.85; height += FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*10.0,noisePos.y*10.0,noisePos.z*10.0,4) * 0.22;
        for (const c of craters){
          const angDist = Math.hypot(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(latDeg - c.latDeg), THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(lonDeg - c.lonDeg));
          const rad = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(c.radiusDeg);
          if (angDist < rad) { const t = 1 - (angDist / rad); height += (Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.4 * 0.6) - (t*t * c.depth); }
        }
        const factor = 1.0 + (height / BASE_RADIUS); pos.setXYZ(i, v.x*factor, v.y*factor, v.z*factor);
      }
      pos.needsUpdate = true; geo.computeVertexNormals(); return geo;
    }

    function buildEuropaGeometry(){
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS, 200, 150);
      const pos = geo.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3();
      for (let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos,i);
        const r=v.length(), nx=v.x/r, ny=v.y/r, nz=v.z/r;
        const lat = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny))), lon = Math.atan2(nz,nx);
        let height = 0; const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*2.2, ny*2.2, nz*2.2, 0.15); height += FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*6.0,noisePos.y*6.0,noisePos.z*6.0,4) * 0.15; 
        const stripe = Math.abs((Math.sin(lon*6.0)*Math.cos(lat*2.0)*0.7) + (Math.sin(lon*3.0+2.0)*Math.sin(lat*4.0)*0.3));
        const ridgeMask = Math.max(0, 1 - stripe*12.0); if (ridgeMask > 0) height += ridgeMask*0.4;
        const factor = 1.0 + (height / BASE_RADIUS); pos.setXYZ(i, v.x*factor, v.y*factor, v.z*factor);
      }
      pos.needsUpdate = true; geo.computeVertexNormals(); return geo;
    }    
    
    function buildSaturnGeometry(){    
      const geo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(BASE_RADIUS, 160, 120); const pos = geo.attributes.position; const v = new THREE.Vector3();    
      for (let i=0;i<pos.count;i++){    
        v.fromBufferAttribute(pos,i); const r=v.length(), nx=v.x/r, ny=v.y/r, nz=v.z/r; const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*1.8, ny*1.8, nz*1.8, 0.55);    
        const band = Math.sin((ny*1.15 + FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*2.2,noisePos.y*2.2,noisePos.z*2.2,4)*0.35) * 12.0); const shear = FastMath.ridged3(noisePos.x*2.4 + 2.0, noisePos.y*1.6, noisePos.z*2.4 - 1.0, 5);    
        let height = band * 0.20 + (shear - 0.5) * 0.40 + FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*5.5,noisePos.y*5.5,noisePos.z*5.5,4) * 0.14; if (Math.abs(ny) > 0.62) height *= 0.6;    
        const factor = 1.0 + (height / BASE_RADIUS); pos.setXYZ(i, v.x*factor, v.y*factor, v.z*factor);    
      }    
      pos.needsUpdate = true; geo.computeVertexNormals(); return geo;    
    }    
    
    function buildRingGeometry(){ const geo = new THREE.RingGeometry(BASE_RADIUS * 1.4, BASE_RADIUS * 2.9, 256); geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2); return geo; }    
    
    function makeMicroMaps(bodyKey){    
      const size = 512; const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = size; const ctx = c.getContext('2d'); const img = ctx.createImageData(size, size); const d = img.data;    
      const k = { saturn: { s: 5.5, warp: 0.55, contrast: 1.08 }, mars: { s: 9.0, warp: 0.45, contrast: 1.35 }, pluto: { s: 7.0, warp: 0.55, contrast: 1.20 }, ceres: { s: 10.0,warp: 0.35, contrast: 1.45 }, europa: { s: 8.0, warp: 0.50, contrast: 1.25 } }[bodyKey] || { s: 8.0, warp: 0.5, contrast: 1.25 };    
      for(let y=0;y<size;y++){    
        for(let x=0;x<size;x++){    
          const u = (x / size) * 2 - 1, v = (y / size) * 2 - 1;    
          const w1 = (FastMath.noise(u*k.s + 12.3, v*k.s + 7.7) * 2 - 1) * k.warp, w2 = (FastMath.noise(u*k.s + 3.1,  v*k.s + 19.2) * 2 - 1) * k.warp;    
          const uu = u*k.s + w1, vv = v*k.s + w2;    
          let n = (FastMath.noise(uu*1.0, vv*1.0) * 0.55) + (FastMath.noise(uu*2.0, vv*2.0) * 0.30) + (FastMath.noise(uu*4.0, vv*4.0) * 0.15);    
          n = Math.pow(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, n)), 1.0 / k.contrast);    
          const idx = (y*size + x) * 4; const g = (n * 255) | 0; d[idx]=g; d[idx+1]=g; d[idx+2]=g; d[idx+3]=255;    
        }    
      }    
      ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0); const bump = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); bump.wrapS = bump.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; bump.repeat.set(2,2); bump.anisotropy = 8; const rough = bump.clone(); rough.needsUpdate = true; return { bump, rough };    
    }    

    // SCAN LOGIC INJECTION
    function injectScanLogic(shader, isFragmentOnly) {
       shader.uniforms.uScanY = { value: -50.0 };
       shader.uniforms.uScanActive = { value: 0.0 };
       const uniformChunk = `uniform float uScanY; uniform float uScanActive;`;
       
       if (!isFragmentOnly) {
           if (!shader.vertexShader.includes('varying vec3 vWorldPos')) {
               shader.vertexShader = 'varying vec3 vWorldPos;\n' + shader.vertexShader.replace('#include <worldpos_vertex>', '#include <worldpos_vertex>\n vWorldPos = (modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0)).xyz;');
           }
           if (!shader.fragmentShader.includes('varying vec3 vWorldPos')) {
               shader.fragmentShader = 'varying vec3 vWorldPos;\n' + shader.fragmentShader;
           }
       }
       shader.fragmentShader = uniformChunk + '\n' + shader.fragmentShader;
       const logicChunk = `if(uScanActive > 0.5) { float scanDist = abs(vWorldPos.y - uScanY); float scanLine = smoothstep(0.8, 0.0, scanDist); float hardLine = smoothstep(0.1, 0.0, scanDist); vec3 scanColor = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.6); float grid = abs(sin(vWorldPos.x*2.0) * sin(vWorldPos.z*2.0)); vec3 gridColor = mix(vec3(0.0), scanColor, grid); vec3 finalScan = mix(gridColor, scanColor, hardLine); gl_FragColor.rgb = mix(gl_FragColor.rgb, finalScan, scanLine * 0.8); }`;
       if (shader.fragmentShader.includes('#include <dithering_fragment>')) {
           shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <dithering_fragment>', '#include <dithering_fragment>\n' + logicChunk);
       } else {
           const lastBrace = shader.fragmentShader.lastIndexOf('}');
           shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.slice(0, lastBrace) + logicChunk + '}';
       }
    }
    
    function applySaturnBandShader(material, opts){    
      const p = Object.assign({ c1: new THREE.Color(0x0d2430), c2: new THREE.Color(0x225a63), c3: new THREE.Color(0xb37a2b), c4: new THREE.Color(0x3a1e15), bandFreq: 10.8, turbulence: 0.55, stormStrength: 0.95, iriStrength: 0.18, iriDarken: 0.42, fresPow: 3.2, limbDarken: 0.30 }, opts || {});    
      material.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => {    
        shader.uniforms.uTime = { value: 0 }; shader.uniforms.uC1 = { value: p.c1 }; shader.uniforms.uC2 = { value: p.c2 }; shader.uniforms.uC3 = { value: p.c3 }; shader.uniforms.uC4 = { value: p.c4 };    
        shader.uniforms.uBandFreq = { value: p.bandFreq }; shader.uniforms.uTurb = { value: p.turbulence }; shader.uniforms.uStorm = { value: p.stormStrength }; shader.uniforms.uIri = { value: p.iriStrength }; shader.uniforms.uIriDark = { value: p.iriDarken }; shader.uniforms.uFresPow = { value: p.fresPow }; shader.uniforms.uLimbDark = { value: p.limbDarken };    
        injectScanLogic(shader, false);
        shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <common>',`#include <common>    
           uniform float uTime; uniform vec3 uC1,uC2,uC3,uC4; uniform float uBandFreq,uTurb,uStorm; uniform float uIri,uIriDark,uFresPow,uLimbDark;    
           float h3(vec3 p){ p = fract(p*0.1031); p += dot(p,p.yzx+33.33); return fract((p.x+p.y)*p.z); }    
           float n3(vec3 p){ vec3 i=floor(p),f=fract(p); f=f*f*(3.0-2.0*f); float n000=h3(i); float n100=h3(i+vec3(1,0,0)); float n010=h3(i+vec3(0,1,0)); float n110=h3(i+vec3(1,1,0)); float n001=h3(i+vec3(0,0,1)); float n101=h3(i+vec3(1,0,1)); float n011=h3(i+vec3(0,1,1)); float n111=h3(i+vec3(1,1,1)); return mix(mix(mix(n000,n100,f.x),mix(n010,n110,f.x),f.y), mix(mix(n001,n101,f.x),mix(n011,n111,f.x),f.y),f.z); }    
           float fbm(vec3 p){ float f=0.0,a=0.5; for(int i=0;i<5;i++){ f+=a*(n3(p)*2.0-1.0); p*=2.0; a*=0.5; } return f; }    
           vec3 thinFilm(float t){ float a=6.28318*t; return vec3(0.5+0.5*cos(a), 0.5+0.5*cos(a+2.1), 0.5+0.5*cos(a+4.2)); }`    
        );
        shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace('vec4 diffuseColor = vec4( diffuse, opacity );',    
          `vec4 diffuseColor = vec4( diffuse, opacity );    
           vec3 N = normalize(vNormal); float lat = asin(N.y); float lon = atan(N.z, N.x);    
           float tNoise = fbm(vec3(lon*1.05, lat*1.35, uTime*0.03)) * uTurb; float band = sin((lat + tNoise*0.35) * uBandFreq); float m = clamp(0.5 + 0.5*band, 0.0, 1.0);    
           vec3 base = mix(mix(uC1,uC2,smoothstep(0.15,0.60,m)), mix(uC3,uC4,smoothstep(0.40,0.90,m)), m);    
           vec2 d = vec2(lon - 1.12, lat + 0.18); d.x *= 1.65; d.y *= 0.95; base += exp(-dot(d,d)*8.0) * uStorm * vec3(0.10,0.06,0.02);    
           float ndv = clamp(dot(N, normalize(vViewPosition)), 0.0, 1.0); float fres = pow(1.0-ndv, uFresPow); vec3 oil = mix(vec3(1.0), thinFilm(fres + n3(N*2.0 + uTime*0.05)), uIri); oil = mix(oil, vec3(0.10), uIriDark); base *= mix(vec3(1.0), oil, fres); base *= mix(1.0 - uLimbDark, 1.0, ndv); diffuseColor.rgb *= base;`    
        );    
        material.userData.shader = shader;    
      };    
      material.needsUpdate = true;    
    }    
    
    function makeOilSlickRingMaterial(seedOffset){    
      const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({    
        transparent: true, depthWrite: false, side: THREE.DoubleSide,    
        uniforms: { uTime: { value: 0 }, uOpacity: { value: 0.92 }, uInner: { value: BASE_RADIUS * 1.4 }, uOuter: { value: BASE_RADIUS * 2.9 }, uFilmScale: { value: 1.28 }, uFresPow: { value: 3.2 }, uNoiseScale: { value: 6.2 }, uDark: { value: 0.16 }, uSeedOffset: { value: seedOffset || 0.0 } },    
        vertexShader: `varying vec3 vPos; varying vec3 vWorldPos; varying vec3 vNormalW; void main(){ vPos = position; vec4 wp = modelMatrix * vec4(position,1.0); vWorldPos = wp.xyz; vNormalW = normalize(mat3(modelMatrix) * normal); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * wp; }`,    
        fragmentShader: `precision highp float; varying vec3 vPos; varying vec3 vWorldPos; varying vec3 vNormalW; uniform float uTime; uniform float uOpacity; uniform float uInner; uniform float uOuter; uniform float uFilmScale; uniform float uFresPow; uniform float uNoiseScale; uniform float uDark; uniform float uSeedOffset;    
          float hash(vec2 p){ vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031); p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33); return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z); }    
          float noise(vec2 p){ vec2 i = floor(p); vec2 f = fract(p); float a = hash(i); float b = hash(i + vec2(1.0, 0.0)); float c = hash(i + vec2(0.0, 1.0)); float d = hash(i + vec2(1.0, 1.0)); vec2 u = f*f*(3.0-2.0*f); return mix(a,b,u.x) + (c-a)*u.y*(1.0-u.x) + (d-b)*u.x*u.y; }    
          float fbm(vec2 p){ float f=0.0, a=0.5; for(int i=0;i<5;i++){ f += a*noise(p); p *= 2.0; a *= 0.5; } return f; }    
          vec3 thinFilm(float t){ float a = 6.28318 * (t * uFilmScale); return vec3(0.5+0.5*cos(a), 0.5+0.5*cos(a+2.1), 0.5+0.5*cos(a+4.2)); }    
          void main(){    
            float r = length(vPos.xz); float t = clamp((r - uInner) / (uOuter - uInner), 0.0, 1.0); vec2 noiseCoord = vec2(t*9.0, 1.2 + uTime*0.02 + uSeedOffset);
            float bands = smoothstep(0.05, 0.85, fbm(noiseCoord)); float gaps  = smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, fbm(vec2(t*26.0, 7.1 + uSeedOffset))) * 0.55; float density = clamp(bands - gaps*0.6, 0.0, 1.0);    
            vec3 V = normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPos); float ndv = clamp(dot(normalize(vNormalW), V), 0.0, 1.0); float fres = pow(1.0 - ndv, uFresPow);    
            float n = fbm(vec2(t*uNoiseScale, uTime*0.03 + uSeedOffset)); vec3 iri = thinFilm(fres + n*0.55);    
            vec3 base = mix(vec3(0.08,0.10,0.12), vec3(0.75,0.78,0.82), density*0.9); vec3 oil = mix(vec3(1.0), iri, 0.62); oil = mix(oil, vec3(0.1), uDark);    
            vec3 col = base * mix(vec3(1.0), oil, fres); float edge = smoothstep(0.0, 0.04, t) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.96, 1.0, t)); float alpha = uOpacity * density * edge;    
            gl_FragColor = vec4(col, alpha);    
          }`    
      });
      const dummyShader = { fragmentShader: mat.fragmentShader, uniforms: mat.uniforms };
      injectScanLogic(dummyShader, true);
      mat.fragmentShader = dummyShader.fragmentShader;
      mat.uniforms.uScanY = dummyShader.uniforms.uScanY;
      mat.uniforms.uScanActive = dummyShader.uniforms.uScanActive;
      return mat;    
    }    
    
    function buildWorld(){    
      // ==== HARD RESET between bodies to prevent cross-body “bleed” ====
      // Saturn-only artifacts (ring clumps, ring cookie, ghost arcs) can otherwise persist.
      // Always clear them first, then rebuild what the active body needs.
      const nextBodyKey = Store.state.body;
      initRingClumps('__clear__'); // always clears existing clumps immediately
      setNightSignalsIntensity(0.0);
      removeRingShadowCookie();

      // Ghost arcs are Saturn-oriented: hide for other bodies (we still keep them built for performance).
      if (ghostArcsGroup) ghostArcsGroup.visible = (nextBodyKey === 'saturn');

      disposeHierarchy(worldMesh); if(worldMesh) scene.remove(worldMesh);    
      ringMeshes.forEach(m => { disposeHierarchy(m); scene.remove(m); }); ringMeshes = [];
      disposeHierarchy(stationMesh); removeStation();
      disposeHierarchy(plumeSystem); removePlumes();
      disposeHierarchy(hudGroup); removeHUD();
      if (atmosphereMesh) { scene.remove(atmosphereMesh); atmosphereMesh.geometry.dispose(); atmosphereMesh.material.dispose(); atmosphereMesh = null; }
    
      const bodyKey = Store.state.body, body = BODIES[bodyKey];    
      let geo, mat;
      const maps = makeMicroMaps(bodyKey);    
    
      if (bodyKey === 'mars') geo = buildMarsGeometry(); else if (bodyKey === 'pluto') geo = buildPlutoGeometry(); else if (bodyKey === 'ceres') geo = buildCeresGeometry(); else if (bodyKey === 'europa') geo = buildEuropaGeometry(); else geo = buildSaturnGeometry();    
    
      if (bodyKey === 'saturn') {    
        mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ roughness: 0.70, metalness: 0.03, bumpMap: maps.bump, bumpScale: 0.10, roughnessMap: maps.rough });    
        applySaturnBandShader(mat, { iriStrength: 0.26, iriDarken: 0.34, turbulence: 0.62, stormStrength: 1.05 });    
      } else {    
        const positions = geo.attributes.position, count = positions.count, colorArr = new Float32Array(count * 3), cFinal = new THREE.Color(), v = new THREE.Vector3();    
        const ss = (min, max, val) => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (val - min) / (max - min)));    
        for (let i=0;i<count;i++){    
          v.fromBufferAttribute(positions, i); const len = v.length(), nx = v.x/len, ny = v.y/len, nz = v.z/len;    
          const lat = Math.asin(Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, ny))), lon = Math.atan2(nz, nx), latDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lat), lonDeg = THREE.MathUtils.radToDeg(lon);    
          const noisePos = FastMath.warp3(nx*2.8, ny*2.8, nz*2.8, 0.35), nBase = FastMath.fbm3(noisePos.x*6.0, noisePos.y*6.0, noisePos.z*6.0, 4), tNoise = nBase * 0.5 + 0.5;    
          if (bodyKey === 'mars') {    
            const cRust = new THREE.Color(0xd95f2e), cDark = new THREE.Color(0x3e1406), cDust = new THREE.Color(0xe6a87c); const h = (len - BASE_RADIUS);    
            cFinal.copy(cRust).lerp(cDark, (1.0 - tNoise) * 0.6);
            if (latDeg > -30 && latDeg < 40 && lonDeg > -160 && lonDeg < -40) cFinal.lerp(cDust, ss(0, 1.5, h) * 0.7);    
            if (Math.abs(latDeg) < 18 && lonDeg > -115 && lonDeg < -35) if ((1.0 - ss(BASE_RADIUS-1.0, BASE_RADIUS, len)) > 0) cFinal.lerp(new THREE.Color(0x200505), 0.9);    
            if (Math.abs(latDeg) > 65) cFinal.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), ss(65, 85, Math.abs(latDeg) + nBase*5.0));    
          } else if (bodyKey === 'pluto') {    
            const cTan = new THREE.Color(0xe3d2b4), cRed = new THREE.Color(0x501010), cIce = new THREE.Color(0xffffff);    
            cFinal.copy(cTan).lerp(new THREE.Color(0x8a6e50), tNoise * 0.4);    
            if (Math.abs(latDeg) < 25 && FastMath.fbm3(nx*3, ny*3, nz*3, 3) > -0.25) cFinal.lerp(cRed, ss(25, 12, Math.abs(latDeg)) * 0.9);    
            if (latDeg > -45 && latDeg < 25 && lonDeg > -50 && lonDeg < 50) { const d = Math.hypot((lonDeg - 5)/45, (latDeg + 15)/30); if (d < 1.0) cFinal.lerp(cIce, ss(1.0, 0.85, d) * 0.95); }    
          } else if (bodyKey === 'ceres') {    
            cFinal.copy(new THREE.Color(0x222222)).lerp(new THREE.Color(0x333338), tNoise);    
            const angDist = Math.hypot(latDeg - 12, lonDeg - 30); if (angDist < 8) { cFinal.lerp(new THREE.Color(0x111111), ss(8, 6, angDist) * 0.5); if (angDist < 2.2) cFinal.lerp(new THREE.Color(0xffffff), ss(2.2, 0.2, angDist)); }    
          } else if (bodyKey === 'europa') {    
            cFinal.copy(new THREE.Color(0xffffff)).lerp(new THREE.Color(0xdcdcdc), tNoise * 0.25);    
            const stripe = Math.abs((Math.sin(lon*6.0)*Math.cos(lat*2.0)*0.7) + (Math.sin(lon*3.0+2.0)*Math.sin(lat*4.0)*0.3)); if (stripe < 0.10) cFinal.lerp(new THREE.Color(0x91502b), ss(0.10, 0.02, stripe) * 0.85);    
          }    
          colorArr[i*3]=cFinal.r; colorArr[i*3+1]=cFinal.g; colorArr[i*3+2]=cFinal.b;    
        }    
        geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colorArr, 3));    
        const matProps = { mars: { rough: 0.85, metal: 0.05, bump: 0.15 }, pluto: { rough: 0.90, metal: 0.02, bump: 0.12 }, ceres: { rough: 1.0, metal: 0.0, bump: 0.25 }, europa: { rough: 0.35, metal: 0.15, bump: 0.04 } }[bodyKey] || { rough: 0.8, metal: 0.05, bump: 0.1 };    
        mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ vertexColors: true, roughness: matProps.rough, metalness: matProps.metal, bumpMap: maps.bump, bumpScale: matProps.bump, roughnessMap: maps.rough });  
        mat.onBeforeCompile = (shader) => { injectScanLogic(shader, false); mat.userData.shader = shader; };
      }    
    
      worldMesh = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); worldMesh.castShadow = true; worldMesh.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(worldMesh);
      addAtmosphereForBody(bodyKey);
    
      if (bodyKey === 'saturn'){    
        const ringGeo = buildRingGeometry();
        const r1 = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, makeOilSlickRingMaterial(0.0)); r1.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(18); r1.castShadow = true; r1.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(r1); ringMeshes.push(r1);
        const r2 = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, makeOilSlickRingMaterial(12.5)); r2.material.uniforms.uOpacity.value = 0.35; r2.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(18); r2.position.y = 0.08; scene.add(r2); ringMeshes.push(r2);
        const r3 = new THREE.Mesh(ringGeo, makeOilSlickRingMaterial(23.1)); r3.material.uniforms.uOpacity.value = 0.35; r3.rotation.x = THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(18); r3.position.y = -0.08; scene.add(r3); ringMeshes.push(r3);
        if (FX.ringShadow) addRingShadowCookie();
        buildStation();
      } else {
        // Ensure Saturn-only stuff is truly gone
        removeRingShadowCookie();
        if (stationMesh) { scene.remove(stationMesh); stationMesh = null; }
      }

      // Saturn-only ghost arcs
      if (ghostArcsGroup) ghostArcsGroup.visible = (bodyKey === 'saturn');

      setBeltVisible(bodyKey === 'ceres');
      buildHUD(bodyKey);
      if (bodyKey === 'europa' || bodyKey === 'pluto') buildPlumes();
      if (!transitionActive) applyBodyCameraPreset(bodyKey);
      // feature hooks
      afterWorldBuilt();
    }    
    
    function buildHUD(bodyKey) {
        hudGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const rMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x00eaff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.3, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
        const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.RingGeometry(BASE_RADIUS * 1.5, BASE_RADIUS * 1.51, 128), rMat);
        ring.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; hudGroup.add(ring);
        const canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width=256; canvas.height=128; const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 20, 40, 0.6)'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,256,128); ctx.strokeStyle = '#00eaff'; ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeRect(0,0,256,128);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00eaff'; ctx.font = '24px Courier New'; ctx.fillText(BODIES[bodyKey].label.toUpperCase(), 20, 40);
        ctx.font = '16px Courier New'; ctx.fillText("GRAVITY: " + BODIES[bodyKey].gravity + " m/s²", 20, 70);
        const panel = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(4, 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas), transparent: true, opacity: 0.8, side: THREE.DoubleSide }));
        panel.position.set(BASE_RADIUS * 1.5, 2, 0); panel.lookAt(0,0,0); hudGroup.add(panel);
        scene.add(hudGroup);
    }
    
    function removeHUD() { if(hudGroup) { scene.remove(hudGroup); hudGroup = null; } }
    function buildPlumes() {
        plumeSystem = new THREE.Group();
        const geo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.5, 4, 16, 4, true);
        const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xaaccff, transparent: true, opacity: 0.4, wireframe: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending });
        for(let i=0; i<3; i++) {
            const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat); m.position.setFromSphericalCoords(BASE_RADIUS, Math.PI - 0.5, Math.random() * Math.PI * 2); m.rotateX(-Math.PI/2); plumeSystem.add(m);
        }
        scene.add(plumeSystem);
    }
    function removePlumes() { if(plumeSystem) { scene.remove(plumeSystem); plumeSystem = null; } }
    let beltMesh;
    function buildAsteroidBelt(){
      if (beltMesh) { scene.remove(beltMesh); beltMesh.geometry.dispose(); beltMesh.material.dispose(); beltMesh = null; }
      const count = 2200; const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3); const colors = new Float32Array(count * 3);
      const c1 = new THREE.Color(0x9ca3af), c2 = new THREE.Color(0x6b7280), c3 = new THREE.Color(0x3f3f46);
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++){
        const r = 48 + (38) * (0.15 + 0.85*Math.pow(Math.random(), 0.55)), ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
        positions[i*3]=Math.cos(ang) * r; positions[i*3+1]=(Math.random()*2 - 1) * 6.0; positions[i*3+2]=Math.sin(ang) * r;
        const col = (Math.random() < 0.5) ? c1 : (Math.random() < 0.85 ? c2 : c3), tint = 0.65 + Math.random()*0.55;
        colors[i*3]=col.r*tint; colors[i*3+1]=col.g*tint; colors[i*3+2]=col.b*tint;
      }
      beltMesh = new THREE.Points(new THREE.BufferGeometry(), new THREE.PointsMaterial({ size: 1.25, map: makeSoftSpriteTexture(), transparent: true, depthWrite: false, vertexColors: true, opacity: 0.0 }));
      beltMesh.geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3)); beltMesh.geometry.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
      beltMesh.frustumCulled = false; scene.add(beltMesh);
    }
    function makeSoftSpriteTexture(){
      const s = 128, c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = s; const ctx = c.getContext('2d');
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(s/2, s/2, 0, s/2, s/2, s/2); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0,0,s,s); return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
    }
    function setBeltVisible(v){ if (beltMesh) { beltMesh.material.opacity = v ? 0.62 : 0.0; beltMesh.visible = v; } }
